title: Gateway content error
responsibility: Constructs the named error used for gateway content failures.

inputs.name: gatewayContentError.message
inputs.description: A string supplied as the message for the new Error when gateway content failure details are needed. The function passes it through without validation or transformation.

outputs.name: gatewayContentError
outputs.description: A newly constructed Error whose message is the supplied string and whose name is set to GatewayContentError. The function returns the error without throwing it.
